primary.title: American Express shares tumble despite robust earnings, higher revenue outlook as rising costs weigh on sentiment
primary.summary: Total card spending, or billed business, climbed 9% year over year to $455.8 billion on a foreign exchange-adjusted basis. Quarterly revenue also rose 10% to $19.6 billion, reflecting healthy consumer activity
